description: The Graduate School of Arts and Science (GSAS) offers more than 50 Master's programs, including the MA, MS, and MFA degrees. Most of these programs are designed for students who are preparing for doctoral study, but some are also designed to prepare students for specific careers or to enhance their professional credentials. GSAS also offers more than 10 dual-degree programs in collaboration with other NYU schools. The majority of these are master's programs.

Concentration name: Accounting, Asset Management, Business Analytics, Corporate Finance, Digital Marketing, Entrepreneurship & Innovation, FinTech, Global Business, Healthcare, Leadership & Change Management, Luxury Marketing, Management of Technology and Operations, Marketing, Product Management, Quantitative Finance, Real Estate, Social Innovation & Impact, Strategy, Supply Chain Management, Sustainable Business & Innovation
description: The NYU Stern Full-time MBA Program prepares students for transformational careers. Our curriculum combines strong academic fundamentals with flexible options to customize your MBA, allowing students to align their studies with their professional goals and interests. Experience a rich student life in the heart of NYC, leverage our robust alumni network, and benefit from career resources that will set you up for success.
Accreditation status: NYU Stern School of Business is accredited by AACSB International (The Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business).

description: The Interactive Telecommunications Program (ITP) is a two-year graduate program that explores the imaginative use of communications technologies and their capacity to affect culture and society. Our mission is to explore and develop the expressive possibilities of new and emerging media, with a focus on interactivity, computation, and community. We are a center for the design and study of new media, for example: creating interactive installations, augmented reality and virtual reality applications, computational art and music, immersive experiences, and much more. ITP is part of the Tisch School of the Arts at NYU.

The NYU Stern Master of Science in Accounting (MS in Accounting) program is designed for students who want to become licensed certified public accountants (CPAs). Students will develop a deep understanding of the global financial reporting environment, tax, audit, and financial advisory. The program is registered as a 150-hour CPA-eligible program and provides graduates with the necessary credits to meet the educational requirements for CPA licensure in New York State and most other states. The MS in Accounting curriculum prepares students for careers in public accounting, corporate finance, and consulting, among other fields. Students acquire the analytical, critical thinking, and communication skills necessary to succeed in a dynamic business environment. A 12-month full-time curriculum is offered to both recent college graduates and those with limited work experience.

Concentration name: International Development, Management and Leadership, Public Policy Analysis, Finance and Quantitative Analysis, Nonprofit Management and Policy
description: NYU Wagner's two-year Master of Public Administration (MPA) degree prepares students for public service leadership positions in government, nonprofit, and for-profit organizations worldwide. Through our rigorous curriculum, students develop critical analytical, management, and leadership skills necessary to address complex social problems. The program emphasizes practical application, allowing students to learn from leading faculty and practitioners, and to gain hands-on experience through internships and capstone projects. Graduates are equipped to drive change, manage programs, and analyze policy across various sectors dedicated to the public good.
Accreditation status: Fully accredited by the Network of Schools of Public Policy, Affairs, and Administration (NASPAA), the global accreditor of public service education programs.

Concentration name: Customized MPH (for current NYU graduate students only)
Veterinary Public Health (joint with Cummings School of Veterinary Medicine at Tufts University)
description: The NYU Master of Public Health (MPH) is a 42-credit practice-based degree program that prepares students to become leaders in public health. Our students are educated to address local, national, and global health challenges by identifying and analyzing health problems, applying evidence-based approaches to design and evaluate interventions, and advocating for policies that promote health equity and social justice. The curriculum emphasizes critical thinking, interdisciplinary collaboration, and effective communication, equipping graduates with the skills necessary to make a meaningful impact on the health and well-being of diverse populations.
Accreditation status: fully accredited by the Council on Education for Public Health (CEPH)

description: The Master of Fine Arts (MFA) in Studio Art program provides an intensive course of study in studio art through the development of professional artistic practice combined with critical research and engagement with contemporary art issues and theory. The program encourages diverse approaches to art-making that challenge disciplinary boundaries, providing opportunities to pursue a broad range of contemporary practices and research topics across art, design, and new media. The Department of Art provides an expansive, interdisciplinary environment that fosters experimentation and innovation within a challenging and supportive atmosphere. Students work closely with faculty mentors, developing strong independent studio practices, and engaging in critical dialogue with peers, faculty, and visiting artists. Students generally select one or two primary areas of focus during their studies. These areas are: Ceramics, Drawing, Painting, Photography, Print Media, Sculpture, and Transmedia (Art and Technology). The three-year program includes 60 credit hours of graduate course work, including graduate seminars, studio courses, and two required teaching assistantships. Students must also complete an MFA thesis project and exhibition.

At NYU Rory Meyers College of Nursing, our Master of Science in Nursing (MSN) program is designed to provide registered nurses with the advanced knowledge and skills necessary to excel in a wide range of specialized practice areas. As a leading institution in nursing education, we are committed to preparing the next generation of nurse leaders, clinicians, and educators to address complex healthcare challenges and improve patient outcomes. Choosing NYU Meyers for your MSN means joining a community dedicated to innovation, research, and compassionate care. Our program offers: Specialized Advanced Practice Areas (diverse concentrations such as Adult-Gerontology, Psychiatric-Mental Health, Pediatric Primary Care, Nurse-Midwifery, Women’s Health, Nursing Administration, and Nursing Education); Expert Faculty (nationally recognized leaders in nursing who bring extensive clinical experience and research expertise to the classroom); Cutting-Edge Curriculum (engage with evidence-based practices, advanced clinical skills, and theoretical frameworks that prepare you for leadership roles); Flexible Learning Options (explore full-time and part-time study options designed to accommodate your professional and personal commitments); Clinical Excellence (gain hands-on experience in top healthcare settings across New York City, working with diverse patient populations and interprofessional teams); Career Advancement (position yourself for advanced roles in healthcare, including nurse practitioner, nurse-midwife, administrator, or educator).
Accreditation status: The Master of Science in Nursing program at New York University Rory Meyers College of Nursing is accredited by the Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education (CCNE), 655 K Street, NW, Suite 750, Washington, DC 20001, 202-887-6791.

Concentration name: Clinical Psychology, Developmental Psychology, Social-Cultural Psychology
description:
The Doctor of Philosophy in Psychology program is a research-oriented program designed to train future psychologists for careers in research and academe. Graduates of the program are expected to make significant contributions to the field of psychology in terms of research, theory building, and application.
The PhD in Clinical Psychology prepares students for the practice of clinical psychology and for leadership roles in mental health service delivery, research, and policy formulation. Students are trained in assessment, diagnosis, and psychotherapy within the scientist-practitioner model.
The PhD in Developmental Psychology focuses on advanced scholarship and research in the scientific study of human development across the lifespan. It emphasizes developmental processes within their socio-cultural context, particularly in the Philippine setting.
The PhD in Social-Cultural Psychology focuses on advanced scholarship and research in social and cultural aspects of human behavior. It emphasizes the dynamic interplay of individual, social, and cultural factors in shaping psychological processes and outcomes, particularly in the Philippine setting.

The Doctor of Education (EdD) in Educational Leadership and Policy Studies prepares students for leadership roles in various educational settings, including K–12 schools, higher education institutions, and non-profit organizations. This program emphasizes a critical approach to understanding and addressing complex issues in education through rigorous research, policy analysis, and practical application. Students develop advanced skills in leadership theory, organizational change, policy development, and data-driven decision-making. The curriculum is designed to foster innovative leaders who can drive equitable and effective educational outcomes.

Our PhD in Counseling Psychology prepares students to become leading researchers, university faculty, and practitioners dedicated to promoting social justice and human rights, especially for marginalized populations. We emphasize an understanding of the individual within family, community, and cultural contexts, and the importance of ecological and systemic approaches to intervention, prevention, and training. The PhD in Counseling Psychology is an APA-accredited program designed to prepare students for careers as counseling psychologists in academic, research, and applied settings. Our program is committed to a scientist-practitioner model of training, emphasizing the integration of scientific inquiry and clinical practice. We prepare students to conduct research that contributes to the scientific understanding of human behavior and to apply evidence-based interventions in diverse contexts. The program provides comprehensive training in psychological assessment, diagnosis, intervention, consultation, and supervision, with a strong emphasis on cultural competence and social justice. Students develop expertise in various theoretical orientations, research methodologies, and professional ethics. Through coursework, practicum experiences, and dissertation research, students cultivate the skills necessary for ethical and effective practice and for advancing the field of counseling psychology.
Accreditation status: APA-accredited program

description: At NYU Law, we believe the best way to teach you to think like a lawyer is to teach you to think critically about the law—about its history, theory, and purpose, and how it is practiced. This is an education that goes beyond mere training; it challenges you to ask questions, question answers, and learn how to shape the law, not just practice it. Our innovative curriculum and extensive offerings, combined with a supportive community and location in the legal capital of the world, provide an unparalleled legal education and an exceptional foundation for your career.
Accreditation status: Approved by the Council of the Section of Legal Education and Admissions to the Bar of the American Bar Association.

Concentration name: Post-BS DNP Pathways: Adult-Gerontology Acute Care Nurse Practitioner; Adult-Gerontology Primary Care Nurse Practitioner; Psychiatric-Mental Health Nurse Practitioner; Pediatric Primary Care Nurse Practitioner; Family Nurse Practitioner; Nurse-Midwifery; Dual Nurse-Midwifery/Women's Health Nurse Practitioner. Post-Master's DNP Pathways: Advanced Practice Leadership; Nursing Administration; Nursing Education.
description: The Doctor of Nursing Practice (DNP) is a practice-focused doctoral degree designed to prepare advanced practice nurses to lead healthcare organizations and systems. The DNP curriculum is grounded in nursing science and emphasizes evidence-based practice, leadership, health policy, and information technology. Graduates are prepared to translate research into practice, lead quality improvement initiatives, and develop innovative healthcare delivery models. The DNP program prepares students for the highest level of nursing practice and provides the knowledge and skills necessary to improve patient outcomes and transform healthcare. Through a rigorous curriculum and extensive clinical experiences, students develop expertise in areas such as advanced health assessment, pathophysiology, pharmacology, data analysis, and program evaluation. The program emphasizes interprofessional collaboration and ethical leadership to address complex healthcare challenges.
Accreditation status: The Doctor of Nursing Practice program at New York University Rory Meyers College of Nursing is accredited by the Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education (CCNE), 655 K Street NW, Suite 750, Washington, DC 20001, 202-887-6791.

description: The NYU Stern Master of Science in Accounting (MSA) program is a specialized one-year graduate program designed for ambitious students seeking to launch a career in accounting and meet the 150-hour educational requirement for CPA licensure. Our rigorous curriculum provides a deep dive into financial reporting, auditing, taxation, and advanced data analytics, preparing graduates for diverse roles in public accounting firms, corporations, and government agencies. Students benefit from Stern’s prime location in New York City, unparalleled career development resources, and a strong alumni network. The program emphasizes critical thinking, ethical reasoning, and professional communication skills essential for leadership in the evolving accounting profession.
Accreditation status: NYU Stern School of Business is accredited by AACSB International (The Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business).

Program name: Adult-Gerontology Acute Care Nurse Practitioner Certificate

description: The Adult-Gerontology Acute Care Nurse Practitioner (AGACNP) program prepares students to provide direct care to adult and geriatric patients in acute care settings through advanced didactic and clinical coursework. The AGACNP specializes in providing care for patients with complex, acute, and chronic health conditions, ranging from young adults to the elderly. Students are prepared to provide care in various acute care settings, including emergency departments, intensive care units, hospitalist services, and specialty practices. Upon completion of the program, graduates are eligible to sit for the Adult-Gerontology Acute Care Nurse Practitioner certification examination offered by the American Nurses Credentialing Center (ANCC) or the American Association of Critical-Care Nurses (AACN).
Accreditation status: The master’s degree program in nursing at NYU Rory Meyers College of Nursing is accredited by the Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education (http://www.ccneaccreditation.org).
Program name: Adult-Gerontology Acute Care Nurse Practitioner MSN
Biochemistry and Molecular Biology Executive PhD Online

description: The Master of Science (MS) in Biology offers students the opportunity to advance their knowledge and skills in various fields of modern biology. The program provides a broad foundation in fundamental biological principles and offers opportunities for specialization through coursework and research. It is designed for students interested in pursuing further graduate studies (including Ph.D. programs), careers in research, biotechnology, health-related fields, environmental science, or education. The program offers both a thesis and non-thesis option. Students in the thesis option complete original research under the guidance of a faculty mentor, culminating in a written thesis and oral defense. The non-thesis option requires a broader range of coursework and can culminate in a capstone project or comprehensive examination. Both options emphasize critical thinking, scientific communication, and advanced laboratory skills, preparing students for diverse professional paths in biology.

The Biology PhD Program is a highly interdisciplinary program that emphasizes student research in cutting-edge areas of modern biology. We attract outstanding students from around the world and provide them with both state-of-the-art facilities and a vibrant, collaborative research environment. Students in the program receive tuition remission and a competitive stipend. Our students come from diverse backgrounds and go on to careers in academia, industry, and teaching. Many alumni have gone on to careers as professors at leading universities, researchers at biotech and pharmaceutical companies, and leaders in science communication.

The M.S. in Biomedical Engineering (MSBE) program at NYU Tandon School of Engineering is designed for those who wish to pursue a deeper understanding and specialization in the rapidly growing field of biomedical engineering. This program provides students with a strong foundation in core biomedical engineering principles, along with opportunities to specialize in various sub-disciplines such as biomechanics, biomaterials, medical imaging, neural engineering, and computational biomedical engineering. Graduates are prepared for careers in research and development, academia, and industry within the healthcare and biotechnology sectors. The curriculum emphasizes both theoretical knowledge and practical skills through coursework, laboratory experiences, and thesis or project options. Students will learn to apply engineering principles to solve complex problems in biology and medicine, contributing to advancements in diagnostics, therapeutics, and healthcare technologies.

Our PhD program is designed for students seeking to contribute original research to the field of biomedical engineering. Through a combination of advanced coursework, rigorous research, and mentorship from leading faculty, students are prepared to become independent researchers and innovators. The program emphasizes interdisciplinary approaches, leveraging NYU's strengths in engineering, medicine, and the sciences to address complex challenges in health and disease.

The Master of Science in Biomedical Engineering (MSBE) with a specialization in Medical Physics is a 30-credit, CAMPEP-accredited program offered in collaboration with the NYU Grossman School of Medicine. Our curriculum educates students in the fundamental physics of medical imaging and radiation therapy while training them to use the latest technologies and research to develop innovative solutions for global health and medical challenges. Rooted in applied physics, mathematics, chemistry, and biology, medical physics uses an engineering approach to address challenges in medicine and human health. Our graduates are prepared for careers in industry, research, and academia. The program can be completed in two years of full-time study, or students can elect to pursue the degree part-time. Our graduates are well-prepared for entry into residency programs in therapeutic medical physics, diagnostic medical physics, nuclear medical physics, or careers in industry. The program is specifically designed to meet the academic requirements for certification in Medical Physics by the American Board of Radiology (ABR).
Accreditation status: CAMPEP-accredited program
Program name: Biomedical Engineering MSBE with emphasis in Medical Physics

description: The Medical Physics PhD Track is a specialization within the Biomedical Engineering PhD Program offered at NYU Tandon School of Engineering. This interdisciplinary PhD track is designed for students interested in pursuing research and a career in medical physics. Our program emphasizes rigorous training in the fundamental principles and clinical applications of medical physics, preparing students to excel in academic, clinical, and industrial settings. Our curriculum offers a unique blend of engineering, physics, and medical coursework, providing students with a comprehensive understanding of imaging, radiation therapy, and related technologies. Students conduct research under the mentorship of faculty from the Department of Radiation Oncology and other departments within NYU Langone Health, as well as faculty from the NYU Tandon School of Engineering. Upon graduation, students are well-prepared for careers as medical physicists in hospitals, research institutions, and industry, or for postdoctoral fellowships leading to academic positions. Graduates are also qualified to pursue residency training in medical physics, which is a requirement for certification by the American Board of Radiology (ABR).
Accreditation status: CAMPEP-accredited (Commission on Accreditation of Medical Physics Educational Programs)
Program name: Biomedical Engineering PhD with emphasis in Medical Physics

description: Our MS in Biomedical Informatics program, offered through NYU Langone Health, is designed for those seeking to gain expertise in the field of biomedical informatics, whether for a career as a practicing informaticist or to apply informatics principles to their primary field. Our program is highly selective and provides comprehensive training in biomedical informatics, including clinical informatics, translational bioinformatics, and public health informatics. Students learn through a competency-based curriculum, which integrates formal coursework, journal clubs, research rotations, a capstone project, and seminars with leaders in the field. Our mission is to prepare future leaders in biomedical informatics to meet the needs of an increasingly data-intensive medical and public health environment. Our graduates gain the knowledge, skills, and professional attitudes to: understand the key concepts in biomedical informatics and how they apply across its subdomains; identify and apply appropriate methodologies and tools to address biomedical informatics problems; develop, evaluate, and implement innovative biomedical informatics solutions; communicate effectively with diverse audiences, including clinicians, researchers, and public health professionals; practice ethical and responsible biomedical informatics.

The Vilcek Institute of Biomedical Sciences at NYU Langone Health is home to a world-class PhD program that prepares the next generation of scientific leaders for careers in basic, translational, and clinical research. Our mission is to provide students with a rigorous and innovative education in biomedical sciences, fostering critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and a deep understanding of biological processes relevant to human health and disease.
The PhD program offers a comprehensive curriculum designed to provide a strong foundation in core biomedical disciplines, including molecular biology, cell biology, genetics, biochemistry, neuroscience, immunology, pharmacology, and computational biology. Students engage in cutting-edge research through laboratory rotations, gaining hands-on experience and identifying their research interests. Throughout their studies, students benefit from close mentorship by our distinguished faculty, who are leaders in their respective fields. We emphasize interdisciplinary collaboration and encourage students to explore diverse research areas within the institute and across NYU Langone Health. Upon completion of the program, graduates are well-equipped to pursue successful careers in academia, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, government, and other scientific enterprises.

The MS in Biostatistics provides rigorous training in statistical theory and methods for the design and analysis of studies in public health, medicine, and biology. The program focuses on quantitative aspects of designing and analyzing studies, including randomized trials, cohort studies, and case-control studies. Students will learn state-of-the-art biostatistical methods for analyzing various types of data encountered in health sciences. Graduates will be able to perform statistical analysis of data, collaborate effectively with scientists in the health fields, prepare oral and written reports, and pursue further graduate studies in biostatistics. The program is designed for students with strong quantitative backgrounds in areas such as mathematics, statistics, computer science, or engineering.

The NYU Stern Executive MBA (EMBA) is a general management program for experienced professionals who are ready to take on greater leadership roles and responsibilities. Our EMBA is designed to accelerate your career, providing you with a deeper understanding of business fundamentals and the strategic acumen needed to lead with confidence in a rapidly evolving global landscape. You will learn to think critically, make data-driven decisions, and inspire teams, all while expanding your network with accomplished peers from diverse industries and backgrounds. The EMBA program at NYU Stern is uniquely designed for working professionals who aspire to advance their careers without pausing their professional lives. The curriculum balances core business principles with a flexible approach, allowing you to tailor your learning experience through a wide selection of electives and specializations. Students gain a comprehensive understanding of global business dynamics, financial markets, marketing strategies, leadership development, and operational excellence. The program emphasizes experiential learning, case studies, and real-world applications, preparing graduates to navigate complex business challenges and drive innovation.
Accreditation status: Accredited by AACSB International, the Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business.

description: The Accounting Specialization prepares students for academic careers at leading research universities. Our curriculum integrates knowledge from accounting, economics, and finance with rigorous analytical and empirical training to conduct research on important topics in financial accounting, managerial accounting, and taxation. Students are required to take advanced courses in economics, econometrics, and statistics. We seek highly motivated individuals interested in conducting rigorous research, developing and applying new theoretical and empirical techniques, and teaching at the university level. Our faculty is engaged in a wide range of research in financial reporting, financial contracting, managerial accounting, and taxation. Recent faculty research has appeared in top academic journals, including The Accounting Review, Journal of Accounting Research, Journal of Accounting and Economics, Review of Accounting Studies, Journal of Finance, Journal of Financial Economics, and The American Economic Review. Our PhD students have received numerous awards, including the AAA/Deloitte/J. Michael Cook Doctoral Consortium Fellowship and the PCAOB Fellowship, and have gone on to hold faculty positions at leading universities, including the University of Chicago, Columbia University, Cornell University, Duke University, Harvard University, INSEAD, London Business School, MIT, University of Pennsylvania, Stanford University, University of Texas at Austin, University of Washington, and Yale University.

The PhD Program in Finance at NYU Stern is designed to prepare students for academic careers in finance. It provides a rigorous and comprehensive training in financial economics, emphasizing both theoretical and empirical methods. The program has a strong research orientation, encouraging students to actively engage in research from the earliest stages of their doctoral studies. Students work closely with Stern’s finance faculty, who are leading scholars in various fields of finance, including corporate finance, asset pricing, behavioral finance, financial econometrics, market microstructure, and FinTech. Graduates of the program are placed in top academic institutions and research organizations worldwide.

Our PhD students in Management investigate the challenges confronting organizations as well as the individuals and teams within them. Research in the Management area addresses topics such as strategy (how firms achieve and sustain competitive advantage), organizational behavior (how individuals and groups act in organizations), and entrepreneurship (how firms are created, grow, and innovate). The Management group faculty share interests in micro-organizational behavior, macro-organizational theory and strategy, and entrepreneurship. Students specializing in Management are trained in a variety of research methods including field studies, laboratory and field experiments, and archival data analysis. The goal is to develop scholars who generate and disseminate knowledge through theory-driven empirical research and prepare them for careers as professors at leading research universities.

Management is one of eight fields of study in the Stern PhD Program. The Management Department at NYU Stern is committed to conducting and disseminating cutting-edge research in a wide array of topics. Our PhD students have the opportunity to work closely with world-renowned faculty members and contribute to the advancement of knowledge in the field. The Management PhD program aims to train students to become leading scholars in top research universities and institutions. Faculty research interests include entrepreneurship, strategy (corporate, competitive, international), organizational theory, organizational behavior, innovation, social networks, and technology management. Our PhD students conduct research in these areas, often taking an interdisciplinary approach and collaborating with faculty from other departments at Stern and across NYU.

The NYU Stern PhD Program in Marketing prepares students for careers as academics at leading business schools and universities around the world. The program focuses on developing the conceptual and technical skills needed to conduct high-quality research in marketing. It covers a broad range of topics, including consumer behavior, quantitative marketing, and marketing strategy. Stern Marketing PhD students work closely with faculty mentors, drawing on their expertise and guidance to develop a strong research portfolio. Our PhD program provides comprehensive training in marketing that enables students to pursue academic careers at the highest level. Students develop expertise in both methodology and theory, allowing them to make significant contributions to the marketing discipline. Students gain extensive research experience by working closely with Stern Marketing faculty on various projects. The program also provides extensive opportunities for students to present their research at leading conferences and to build their professional networks.

description: At Stern, you can earn your MBA without missing a beat in your career. Our Part-time MBA program allows students to complete their degree at an accelerated two-year pace or a more flexible timeframe (up to six years), while working full-time. Classes meet on weeknights in our state-of-the-art campus in the heart of Greenwich Village in Manhattan. Part-time MBA students take the same courses, with the same faculty, and earn the same degree as Full-time MBA students. The Part-time MBA program provides the flexibility to complete your MBA degree while continuing to advance in your career. There is no separate application for the Accelerated Two-Year Path. Your pace can be adjusted at any point during your studies. You will earn the same MBA degree as full-time students.
Accreditation status: NYU Stern School of Business is accredited by AACSB International – The Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business.

description: Stern's Part-time MBA in Manhattan offers an Accelerated Two-Year Option, allowing students to earn their MBA in two academic years. You can complete your MBA faster by opting for the Accelerated Two-Year Option. This allows students to take up to 24 credits (8 courses) per semester, for a total of 48 credits over two academic years. You can take a variety of courses within our over 20 specializations, as well as take electives from outside Stern. To take advantage of the accelerated option, students must complete at least 24 credits by the end of their first year. The Accelerated Two-Year Option is available to students in all of Stern’s Part-time MBA programs (Manhattan, Washington Square, and Online).
Program name: Business Administration Accelerated MBA in Real Estate

description: The Healthcare specialization is designed to prepare students for leadership roles within the dynamic global healthcare industry. Students gain a deep understanding of the unique challenges and opportunities in healthcare through courses that cover a wide range of topics, including healthcare economics, policy, operations, and strategy. This specialization provides the analytical tools and strategic frameworks necessary to navigate the complex landscape of healthcare organizations, from hospitals and pharmaceutical companies to health tech startups and government agencies. Graduates are equipped to drive innovation, improve patient outcomes, and contribute to the evolution of healthcare delivery and management globally.
Program name: Business Administration Executive MBA in Health Management and Policy

description: The Global Executive MBA program is an executive-level general management degree designed for high-potential, experienced professionals who seek to enhance their leadership skills, expand their global perspective, and drive innovation within their organizations. The curriculum emphasizes strategic thinking, cross-cultural collaboration, and data-driven decision-making, preparing graduates to navigate complex global business challenges and lead with impact. Through a blend of rigorous coursework, immersive global experiences, and peer learning, students develop a holistic understanding of global business environments and cultivate the competencies necessary to lead effectively in diverse organizational settings.

The Online Modular Option provides the structure, rigor, and academic excellence of the Part-time MBA in a flexible hybrid format, blending online learning with immersive in-person modules. Our flexible curriculum allows you to select from a full suite of electives and specializations. Online Modular students take a combination of required core courses and electives. Our flexible curriculum allows you to select from a full suite of electives and specializations. Stern offers over 20 specializations, allowing you to tailor your MBA to your specific career goals. Students also have the opportunity to participate in experiential learning courses (e.g., Stern Solutions) and take courses through our international options (e.g., Doing Business In...). Our flexible curriculum includes: Required Core Courses: The core curriculum provides a strong foundation in key business disciplines. Electives: Online Modular students can choose from a full suite of electives across various disciplines. Specializations: Students can choose from over 20 specializations offered at NYU Stern, allowing you to tailor your MBA to your specific career goals. Experiential Learning: Stern offers various opportunities for experiential learning, allowing students to apply classroom knowledge to real-world business challenges. International Options: Online Modular students have the opportunity to participate in international courses that offer a global perspective on business.
Accreditation status: AACSB International – The Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business.

description: The NYU Stern Master of Science in Business Analytics (MSBA) program is designed for experienced professionals who want to learn how to leverage data to make better business decisions and become leaders in the field. Offered on a part-time basis over one year, students are trained in the latest data science techniques and learn to apply them in real-world business contexts. Graduates gain the skills to analyze complex business data, build predictive and prescriptive models, and use evidence-based insights to solve complex challenges across a variety of industries. The program uniquely combines Stern’s expertise in business education with cutting-edge data science techniques, preparing students to drive strategic impact in data-driven organizations.
Accreditation status: Accredited by AACSB International, the Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business.

description: Unlock your potential in the digital economy with the NYU Stern Business Technology MS Online program. This cutting-edge master's degree empowers professionals to lead at the intersection of business strategy and technological innovation. Our comprehensive curriculum covers essential domains such as data science foundations, cybersecurity best practices, AI and machine learning applications in business, digital product management, and strategic IT leadership. Designed for ambitious individuals from diverse backgrounds, the program hones your analytical acumen and decision-making capabilities, preparing you for influential roles in technology consulting, data strategy, digital transformation, and more. Benefit from Stern's world-renowned faculty and a dynamic global network, all delivered through a flexible online format. Elevate your career with a degree that defines the future of business.

The Molecular Oncology & Tumor Immunology (MOTI) PhD Training Program focuses on providing comprehensive training in the cellular and molecular mechanisms of cancer and anti-tumor immunity. Our program is a part of the Vilcek Institute of Graduate Biomedical Sciences at NYU Langone Health. Research in MOTI includes topics such as molecular pathogenesis of cancer; oncogenes and tumor suppressors; tumor microenvironment; tumor metabolism; epigenetics of cancer; genomic instability; DNA damage and repair; cancer stem cells; metastasis; cancer prevention and early detection; tumor immunology; immunotherapy; cellular therapies; virology and infectious diseases related to cancer. These research areas encompass basic and translational approaches aimed at understanding the biology of cancer and developing novel therapeutic interventions against the disease. Students in the MOTI program learn to critically evaluate scientific literature, design and perform experiments, and effectively communicate scientific findings. Our goal is to train future leaders in cancer research, equipped with the knowledge and skills necessary to make significant contributions to the field.

Program name: Cellular Physiology and Molecular Biophysics PhD

description: The MS program in Chemical Engineering is designed to provide students with advanced knowledge in chemical engineering fundamentals, as well as in emerging areas of the field. Students can choose between a thesis or non-thesis option, allowing for flexibility in their academic pursuits. Our graduates are well-prepared for careers in industries such as chemical manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, energy, and environmental engineering, or for further graduate studies.
Program name: Chemical, Environmental, and Materials Engineering MS
Chemical, Environmental, and Materials Engineering PhD

description: The M.S. program is a course-work based, terminal degree program. The M.S. degree generally entails completion of 32 points of graduate-level coursework (8 courses). M.S. students also complete a thesis or non-thesis research project culminating in a written report and presentation. Completion of the M.S. degree generally takes two years. The M.S. program can be used to prepare students for a career in industry or as a gateway to Ph.D. studies either at NYU or at another university. The specific program of study is determined in consultation with the Director of Graduate Studies.

The Department of Chemistry offers a program of graduate study leading to the Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) degree. The Ph.D. program in Chemistry at NYU is designed to train independent, innovative researchers and educators in the chemical sciences. Students pursue advanced coursework, engage in cutting-edge laboratory research under the guidance of faculty, and actively participate in seminars and scientific conferences. The curriculum provides a comprehensive understanding of core chemical principles across various sub-disciplines including analytical, inorganic, organic, physical, and biological chemistry. Graduates are well-prepared for leadership roles in academia, industrial research and development, and government agencies.

The Master of Music in Choral Conducting program at NYU Steinhardt is designed for talented and experienced musicians who intend to pursue advanced careers in choral music in a variety of settings, from churches and schools to professional ensembles. Our program focuses on fostering students' individual growth through a comprehensive curriculum of coursework, practical experience, and a thesis project or professional performance project. You'll work closely with renowned faculty, gaining in-depth knowledge of conducting techniques, rehearsal strategies, vocal pedagogy, and choral literature.
Accreditation status: Accredited by the National Association of Schools of Music (NASM)

description: Our choral conducting programs prepare students for professional careers in conducting, teaching, and scholarship at the highest levels. The MM in Choral Conducting and the DMA in Choral Conducting are professional degrees that provide comprehensive instruction in conducting technique, score analysis, rehearsal techniques, choral literature, and vocal pedagogy. Students gain extensive conducting experience with NYU choirs, including the NYU Contemporary Music Ensemble, NYU University Singers, and NYU Brass Ensemble. Our faculty are active professionals with extensive experience in leading choirs of all types and at all levels. Graduates of our programs are successful conductors, educators, and leaders in the field of choral music.
Accreditation status: The NYU Steinhardt Department of Music and Performing Arts Professions is an accredited institutional member of the National Association of Schools of Music.

description: The Civil Engineering MS program at NYU Tandon School of Engineering offers advanced study in various specialized areas of civil engineering. Students can choose from a wide range of courses and research opportunities, preparing them for leadership roles in industry, government, and academia. The program emphasizes innovative solutions to complex infrastructure challenges, sustainable design, and the application of cutting-edge technologies. Our faculty are experts in their fields, committed to providing a rigorous and engaging educational experience. Graduates are equipped with the knowledge and skills to address critical issues in areas such as structural engineering, transportation, environmental engineering, construction management, and urban infrastructure systems, contributing to resilient and sustainable communities.

Concentration name: Environmental Engineering, Structural Engineering and Mechanics, Transportation Planning and Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction Management
description: The Doctor of Philosophy in Civil Engineering degree program is designed to educate students to become researchers, educators, and leaders in academia, industry, and government. PhD students work closely with faculty members on cutting-edge research projects, often contributing to advancements in areas such as environmental engineering, structural mechanics, transportation systems, and urban infrastructure. Students typically specialize in one of the research areas offered within the department, conducting original research that culminates in a dissertation. The program emphasizes critical thinking, advanced analytical techniques, and effective communication of scientific findings. Graduates are prepared for careers that demand advanced technical knowledge and research expertise.

Our PhD in Civil Engineering helps students conduct research, develop innovations, and push the field forward. Students are able to specialize in various areas of Civil Engineering, including structural engineering, transportation engineering, construction management, water resources and environmental engineering, smart cities, and urban infrastructure systems.
Program name: Civil Engineering PhD with emphasis in Architectural Engineering

description: The PhD in Civil Engineering is a research degree awarded to students who demonstrate a high level of scholarship, original investigation, and breadth of knowledge through the completion of advanced coursework, successful passing of written and oral examinations, and the preparation and defense of an original dissertation. The Civil and Urban Engineering Department prepares students for careers in research and development, teaching, or advanced practice in the profession of civil engineering. Research areas cover a wide variety of topics, including construction management, environmental engineering, geotechnical engineering, structural engineering and mechanics, and transportation engineering. The Ph.D. program is individualized to suit each student’s background and interests. An advisory committee works with the student to create a program of study tailored to their specific interests.
Program name: Civil Engineering PhD with emphasis in Environmental Engineering

description: The Master of Science (MS) in Clinical Investigation is a comprehensive program designed to provide students with the foundational knowledge and practical skills required for a career in clinical and translational research. Through a curriculum integrating didactic coursework with mentored research experiences, students learn about study design, biostatistics, data management, research ethics, and scientific communication. The program aims to train future independent investigators capable of designing and conducting rigorous, ethical, and impactful research studies.

The Master of Professional Science (MPS) degree in Coastal Zone Management is designed to equip students with the skills and knowledge to address the growing challenges of managing coastal and marine environments. This interdisciplinary program focuses on understanding the complex interactions between human activities and natural coastal processes, preparing graduates for leadership roles in government agencies, non-profit organizations, and private consulting firms involved in coastal planning, conservation, and sustainable development. Students will learn about policy and law, economic considerations, ecological principles, and practical management techniques relevant to coastal ecosystems and communities.

The PhD program in Media, Culture, and Communication is a rigorous, interdisciplinary program dedicated to the critical study of media and communication. Our doctoral program trains students to become leading scholars in the field, equipped to conduct original research, teach at the university level, and contribute to public discourse on media and its societal impact. The program emphasizes theoretical depth, methodological rigor, and critical engagement with diverse forms and practices of media and communication. Students work closely with faculty mentors to develop their research interests, culminating in a dissertation that makes a significant contribution to the field. Our graduates go on to careers in academia, research, and policy-making.

Program name: Communication for Global Social Change MA

description: The MA in Media, Culture, and Communication (MCC) at NYU Steinhardt provides a critical understanding of the role of media and communication in society. Our program prepares students for careers in media industries, non-profit organizations, government, and academia, as well as for further graduate study at the doctoral level. You’ll develop analytical, research, and communication skills applicable to a wide range of professional contexts. Our MA in Media, Culture, and Communication program provides a comprehensive, critical, and interdisciplinary approach to the study of media and communication. You will explore the complex relationships between media, technology, culture, and society, examining how they shape and are shaped by historical, political, economic, and social forces. Our program emphasizes theoretical rigor, research-based inquiry, and practical application. You will develop critical thinking skills, a nuanced understanding of global communication issues, and the ability to effectively communicate complex ideas.

NYU Steinhardt offers master of music and doctor of philosophy degrees in composition, providing an environment for exploring a broad range of compositional approaches from classical to avant-garde, electronic, multimedia, film, and jazz. Our Composition MM will provide you with the necessary tools, skills, and creative strategies to pursue a career as a composer for media or the concert stage, or as a preparation for doctoral study. You will develop an individual compositional voice while exploring new concepts and techniques across diverse genres. Our dedicated faculty comprises professional composers who will help you find your unique path as an artist. At the core of the Composition MM is the private composition lesson, which encourages an intensive, one-on-one relationship between a student and a faculty mentor. Regular student performance forums, composers’ colloquia, and opportunities to collaborate with other performers and multimedia artists are an integral part of our program. You will also take courses in advanced theory and analysis, orchestration, contemporary music literature, electronic music, and film scoring. Our graduates have pursued careers as composers for film and television, games, advertising, and the concert stage, as well as educators and performers. Some have continued their studies in prestigious doctoral programs.
Accreditation status: The Department of Music is an accredited institutional member of the National Association of Schools of Music (NASM).

description: The Doctor of Musical Arts (DMA) in Composition is designed for advanced composers who wish to pursue the highest level of artistic and academic training in their field. This program emphasizes intensive practical experience in composition, combined with rigorous scholarly inquiry and research. Students engage with a wide range of compositional techniques, explore diverse musical styles, and develop their unique artistic voices. The curriculum includes advanced studies in music theory, history, aesthetics, and analysis, alongside opportunities for collaboration with performers, ensembles, and other artists. Graduates are prepared for careers as composers, educators, researchers, and leaders in the music industry, equipped with the skills to contribute significantly to the evolving landscape of contemporary music.

The MS in Computer Science is a two-year, 36-credit program that prepares students for a career in the computing industry or for further graduate study. Students can choose to pursue the program on a full-time or part-time basis. The MS program provides students with a solid foundation in computer science and the opportunity to specialize in various areas of interest. The program aims to develop students' analytical, problem-solving, and research skills, enabling them to tackle complex computational challenges. Our graduates are highly sought after by top technology companies and research institutions.

The Ph.D. program in Computer Science at NYU is designed for students who want to become researchers and professors at universities or research scientists in industry. Our students perform cutting-edge research in a wide array of areas, with a focus on fundamental problems and lasting solutions. The PhD program prepares students for positions as research scientists and professors. Doctoral students are expected to make significant original contributions to computer science and must write and defend a thesis presenting their original research. PhD students pursue research in one of the many subfields of computer science supervised by our faculty members. The program generally requires five years of full-time study.

The MS in Construction Management at NYU Tandon School of Engineering offers a rigorous curriculum to prepare students for successful careers in leadership roles within the construction industry. With a focus on sustainable construction, innovative technologies, and data-driven decision-making, the program equips graduates with the skills to manage complex construction projects efficiently and effectively. Students gain expertise in areas such as project planning and scheduling, cost estimation and control, risk management, and legal aspects of construction. The curriculum integrates theoretical knowledge with practical applications, including real-world case studies and project-based learning. Graduates are well-prepared to tackle the challenges of the modern construction landscape and contribute to the development of resilient and sustainable infrastructure.

Designed for experienced construction professionals, the Executive Master of Science (MS) in Construction Management provides a cutting-edge curriculum in advanced construction technologies, project delivery systems, business and finance, risk management, sustainability, and data analytics. Students gain knowledge and skills to lead complex projects and drive innovation in their organizations. The program is designed to be completed in two years of part-time study and culminates in a capstone project. Coursework is delivered one weekend per month with additional online sessions, allowing participants to continue their careers while pursuing their degree.

The Executive Certificate in Construction Management provides working professionals with advanced knowledge and skills in construction management without requiring them to pursue a full master’s degree. Students are taught by world-class faculty, many of whom are senior practitioners in the field. The program is designed for experienced engineers, architects, construction managers, project managers, and other professionals interested in deepening their understanding of construction management principles and practices. It covers topics such as project planning and control, construction methods and technology, legal and contractual aspects, risk management, and sustainability in construction. Through a blend of theoretical knowledge and practical applications, participants gain the expertise needed to lead complex construction projects effectively and efficiently.

The Corporate Finance Certificate is a four-course program that equips you with the knowledge and tools to analyze and make critical financial decisions that drive company value. You will learn to assess the value of a company from the perspective of equity and debt holders; understand how to evaluate corporate investment opportunities through discounted cash flow (DCF) valuation; evaluate the advantages and disadvantages of different financing instruments and payout policies; develop skills in real options, capital budgeting, and other critical financial tools; learn how to manage financial risk by using derivatives for hedging; understand the impact of corporate governance on firms’ financial policies; and apply the concepts learned to real-world business challenges. Upon completing the Certificate, you will have a deeper understanding of key concepts in corporate finance and be able to implement them to create value for your organization.

The MSEd in Counseling offers a Master's degree in counseling to prepare students for careers as counselors in clinical mental health settings or in K-12 school settings. The program is committed to developing socially conscious counselors who are highly skilled in counseling practice, advocacy, and social justice. The curriculum emphasizes the application of evidence-based practices to address the needs of diverse individuals, families, and communities. Students are trained to work in a variety of settings, including community mental health centers, hospitals, private practice, schools, and universities. Graduates are eligible for licensure as Licensed Mental Health Counselors (LMHC) in New York State or certification as School Counselors in New York State.
Accreditation status: The MSEd in Counseling program is fully accredited by the Council for Accreditation of Counseling and Related Educational Programs (CACREP) in both its Clinical Mental Health Counseling and School Counseling specializations.

description: NYU Steinhardt's MA in Counseling and Mental Health and Wellness prepares you to work with diverse populations across a variety of settings. Our program offers two areas of study: Mental Health Counseling and School Counseling. This program provides the academic foundation to pursue licensure in Mental Health Counseling (LMHC) in New York State or certification in School Counseling, as well as licensure in other states. As a student in the Mental Health Counseling area of study, you'll learn to help clients navigate mental and emotional health challenges and disorders, as well as promote mental wellness and personal growth. Through your studies, you'll gain practical experience in assessment, diagnosis, treatment planning, and evidence-based interventions while developing cultural competency and ethical practice standards. This program prepares you for licensure as a Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) in New York State and other states. Our students go on to work in a variety of settings, including community mental health agencies, hospitals, college counseling centers, and private practice.
Accreditation status: Our MA in Counseling and Mental Health and Wellness is accredited by the Council for Accreditation of Counseling and Related Educational Programs (CACREP).
Program name: Counseling MSEd in Mental Health Counseling

description: Our PhD in Counseling Psychology program trains students to become leaders in research, practice, and advocacy in counseling psychology. Graduates are prepared for careers as licensed psychologists in academic, research, and clinical settings. Students develop an appreciation for human diversity and social justice, and learn to apply psychological theories and research to understand and address individual, group, and organizational issues related to mental health and well-being. Our program is committed to a scientist-practitioner model of training, emphasizing the integration of scientific inquiry and evidence-based practice. Students develop expertise in research methodologies, psychological assessment, intervention strategies, and ethical practice. A distinctive feature of our program is its strong emphasis on social justice, multicultural competence, and advocacy for underserved populations. Our faculty are actively engaged in research and clinical work related to these areas, providing students with opportunities to contribute to meaningful projects that impact communities.
Accreditation status: The Counseling Psychology PhD program is accredited by the American Psychological Association (APA).

Concentration name: Digital Media, Entrepreneurship, Finance, Information Systems, Marketing, Operations Management, Supply Chain Management, Telecommunications
description: The M.S. in Management of Technology (MOT) program is designed for engineers, scientists, and professionals in quantitative fields who want to accelerate their careers in technology management, entrepreneurship, and innovation. The program combines management theory with technical knowledge and prepares students for leadership roles in technology-driven organizations. Students will learn to analyze market dynamics, evaluate new technologies, develop business strategies, manage product lifecycles, and lead technical teams. The curriculum emphasizes the application of management principles to real-world technology challenges, fostering a unique blend of business acumen and technological expertise.

The Master of Science program in biology is intended for students who wish to obtain an advanced degree in biology without undertaking the full requirements of the PhD. The master’s degree can serve as a stepping stone to a PhD, as preparation for medical, dental, and other health-related professional programs, or for careers in biotechnology, education, or other science-related fields. The program is flexible and may be tailored to a student’s particular interests, including concentrations in specific areas such as bioinformatics, computational biology, ecology, evolution, developmental biology, genomics, molecular biology, neurobiology, and plant biology. Students are strongly encouraged to undertake a research project in a faculty laboratory.

The Marine Ecosystems and Society Master of Professional Studies (MPS) degree addresses the growing need for environmental professionals in marine science, management, and policy. Offered through NYU SPS’s Division of Programs in Business in conjunction with NYU’s Tandon School of Engineering and the Office of Global Programs, the program provides students with a multidisciplinary understanding of marine ecosystems and the tools needed to manage human interaction with the marine environment. The program delves into current issues impacting oceans and coasts, including climate change, pollution, overfishing, and habitat destruction. It emphasizes a blend of scientific understanding, policy analysis, and management strategies to develop effective solutions. Students will learn how to bridge the gap between scientific research and practical conservation efforts, preparing them for leadership roles in government agencies, non-profit organizations, and the private sector. The curriculum integrates core courses in marine science, environmental law and policy, and data analysis with opportunities for hands-on experience through field work, research projects, and internships. Graduates will emerge with the knowledge and skills to contribute to the sustainable management and conservation of marine ecosystems globally.

The Marine Geosciences program at NYU Tandon School of Engineering is an interdisciplinary master’s program drawing on the diverse research expertise of faculty from the Department of Civil and Urban Engineering and the Department of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering. It is uniquely positioned to address the complex challenges posed by our rapidly changing planet. The curriculum is rooted in a fundamental understanding of earth sciences, oceanography, and environmental engineering principles, providing students with a comprehensive foundation in marine ecosystems, geological processes, and the interactions between human activities and the marine environment. Through a blend of rigorous coursework, hands-on field experience, and cutting-edge research opportunities, students learn to analyze data, develop innovative solutions, and contribute to the sustainable management of marine resources. The program emphasizes critical thinking, problem-solving, and effective communication, preparing graduates for leadership roles in academia, industry, government, and non-profit organizations focused on ocean conservation, coastal zone management, offshore energy, and climate change adaptation.

Materials science and engineering is an interdisciplinary field built on the basic sciences of physics, chemistry and mathematics, as well as the engineering sciences. It focuses on the fundamental relationships between the processing, structure, properties and performance of materials, and encompasses all classes of materials, including metals, ceramics, polymers, semiconductors, composites and biomaterials. The Materials Engineering MS program at NYU Tandon School of Engineering offers a comprehensive curriculum that integrates the various facets of materials science and engineering and provides students with a strong foundation in both the fundamentals and practical applications of the field.

The program is designed to prepare students for careers in research and development, manufacturing, and technical management in a wide range of industries, including aerospace, automotive, electronics, energy, biomedical, and advanced manufacturing. Graduates will be equipped to tackle complex challenges related to material selection, design, processing, characterization, and failure analysis.

Students will gain expertise in:
*   Material Characterization: Understanding and applying various experimental techniques to analyze the structure, composition, and properties of materials.
*   Mechanical Behavior of Materials: Investigating the response of materials to external forces, including elasticity, plasticity, fracture, and fatigue.
*   Thermodynamics and Kinetics of Materials: Applying principles of thermodynamics and kinetics to understand phase transformations, diffusion, and reaction processes in materials.
*   Materials Processing: Learning about different manufacturing processes used to produce materials with desired properties, such as solidification, powder metallurgy, thin-film deposition, and additive manufacturing.
*   Computational Materials Science: Utilizing computational tools and simulations to predict material behavior and design new materials.
*   Advanced Materials: Exploring emerging materials such as nanomaterials, smart materials, and biomaterials, and their applications.

The curriculum is flexible, allowing students to tailor their studies to their specific interests through a selection of elective courses. Research opportunities with faculty are also available, providing students with hands-on experience in cutting-edge materials research.

The MS in Mathematical Finance Program provides rigorous training in the analytical techniques of financial engineering. Students acquire the mathematical and computational skills required for positions in quantitative finance. They learn to design and implement innovative financial products, strategies, and risk management solutions. The program combines a strong theoretical foundation in mathematical finance with practical applications, including empirical techniques, software tools, and communication skills.

The M.S. in Mathematics is designed for students who desire a deeper understanding of mathematics and its applications beyond the bachelor’s degree, but who do not plan to pursue doctoral studies. The program provides the mathematical background for a variety of careers in industry, government, or education. It can also serve as preparation for students wishing to pursue doctoral studies in fields related to applied mathematics such as computer science, statistics, or operations research.

The M.S. in Mathematics is a two-year degree for students with an undergraduate mathematics background. We offer two tracks: a pure and applied mathematics track and a track in mathematics with a specialization in data science. Students can choose between a standard MS or an MS with thesis. The first year of the program is spent building a solid foundation in core mathematics courses. The second year focuses on advanced topics and research, culminating in either a comprehensive exam or a thesis defense. Our faculty are leaders in their fields, committed to providing a rigorous and supportive learning environment. Students benefit from access to cutting-edge research opportunities, seminars, and collaborations across various departments and institutes within NYU. Graduates of our program are well-prepared for careers in academia, industry, government, and finance, or for further doctoral studies.

Our Ph.D. program in Mathematics prepares students for careers in research and teaching at colleges and universities, and for research positions in industry and government. Students may specialize in pure or applied mathematics. The program provides broad and deep training in the fundamental areas of mathematics. Our doctoral students acquire the knowledge and skills necessary to contribute to mathematical research and scholarship. The Department of Mathematics, within the Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences, is one of the top-ranked mathematics graduate programs in the world. Many of its faculty members are leaders in their fields, and a number of its graduates have gone on to distinguished careers. The Department is especially well-known for its strengths in applied mathematics and analysis, and its excellent faculty in algebra, geometry, logic, number theory, and probability. Students in the Ph.D. program choose a specific area of concentration for their thesis research, and they may choose to fulfill some requirements in an interdisciplinary manner. Students are expected to complete the program in five years.

Concentration name: General Mechanical Engineering; Mechatronics and Robotics
description: The Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering (MAE) at NYU Tandon School of Engineering offers a Master of Science (MS) in Mechanical Engineering that will provide you with a comprehensive understanding of the theory and principles of mechanical engineering. Our rigorous curriculum emphasizes both fundamentals and cutting-edge topics in areas such as robotics, smart materials, fluid mechanics, renewable energy, and sustainable design. Graduates are prepared for leadership roles in industry, government, and academia, or for further doctoral studies.

The Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Mechanical Engineering is granted in recognition of the candidate's mastery of the theory and practice of mechanical engineering, and their ability to conduct advanced, original research. The goal of the program is to educate future academic, government, and industrial leaders in mechanical engineering by training students in fundamental and applied topics, as well as providing opportunities to conduct cutting-edge research. The program emphasizes the interdisciplinary nature of mechanical engineering and its growing role in areas such as biotechnology, nanotechnology, and sustainable energy. The core curriculum ensures that students have a strong foundation in mechanical engineering principles, while a wide range of elective courses and research opportunities allow students to tailor their studies to their specific interests.

Our MA curriculum is focused on the critical study of media and communication through an interdisciplinary lens grounded in social science, humanities, and critical theory. We are dedicated to exploring media, culture, and communication in global and historical contexts, and we emphasize the social, cultural, political, and economic dimensions of media in the United States and around the world. Our students acquire the skills necessary for rigorous critical analysis and research in media and cultural studies. Our curriculum emphasizes the acquisition of critical and methodological skills that prepare students for either further academic study or employment in a variety of industries and organizations concerned with understanding the social meaning and impact of media. Students take foundational courses in media theory and research methods, then select from a wide array of specialized courses addressing topics such as digital media, global media, media industries, critical race and media studies, communication and technology, gender and media, and media history. The program culminates in either a thesis or an extended research project.

The NYU SPS Tisch Institute for Global Sport offers the Certificate in Media Management to prepare professionals for roles in managing and developing media businesses and content. This cutting-edge, graduate-level program brings together the critical business skills required to succeed in the dynamic world of media management. The NYU SPS Tisch Institute for Global Sport’s Media Management Certificate is a graduate-level program that examines the current media landscape and prepares students for roles in developing and managing media businesses and content across various sectors. The program is designed to develop the critical business skills required to succeed in the dynamic world of media management today, providing courses focused on finance, strategy, marketing, and the rapidly changing media ecosystem.
The Media Scoring and Production program at NYU Steinhardt prepares students for professional careers as composers and producers in film, television, interactive media, and other visual arts.

The MM in Music Theory and Composition: Screen Scoring is a comprehensive two-year master’s program with instruction that balances practical training with a critical engagement of music and its relationship to visual media. Students will study with faculty and mentors who are actively involved in the industry, and they will participate in a number of professional development and networking opportunities. Through a balance of seminar and practical studio-based work, students will be prepared to work as composers, orchestrators, and music producers for film, television, games, advertising, and other forms of visual media. The program provides an immersive, project-based curriculum focused on developing the compositional, orchestrational, technological, and entrepreneurial skills needed to navigate the ever-evolving entertainment industry. Students develop an extensive portfolio of their creative work in conjunction with opportunities for live recordings of their compositions. Students also engage with the cultural, historical, and aesthetic dimensions of music for visual media, focusing on current issues and emerging practices within the field. This includes topics like: Developing compositional and orchestrational skills; Learning about music technology, including digital audio workstations and software synthesizers; Understanding the business aspects of screen scoring; Exploring the history and aesthetics of film music; Gaining experience through internships and professional opportunities.
Program name: Media Scoring and Production MM Online

description: NYU’s MA in Medical Humanities and Bioethics offers students a flexible, interdisciplinary course of study in medicine and its social, cultural, ethical, historical, philosophical, and literary dimensions. Students can choose from a range of courses in disciplines such as bioethics, disability studies, the history of medicine, gender and sexuality studies, medical anthropology, the medical humanities, and science and technology studies. Situated in the Division of Medical Humanities in NYU Langone Health, the MA program is led by world-renowned experts in bioethics and medical humanities and offers students the opportunity to learn from leading scholars, clinicians, and researchers in the field. The MA in Medical Humanities and Bioethics prepares students for careers in medical ethics, public health, health advocacy, science writing, research, and policy. It also offers excellent preparation for further graduate study in the humanities and social sciences or for professional school in medicine, law, or public health.

The Medical Physics Certificate Program offers an immersive curriculum that delves into the foundational concepts of medical physics, encompassing radiation physics, imaging physics, and nuclear medicine. The program is designed for graduate students who seek to specialize in the rapidly evolving field of medical physics, equipping them with the theoretical knowledge and practical skills essential for a career in clinical settings, research, or industry.

The MS in Mathematics program at the NYU Tandon School of Engineering offers students a flexible curriculum that allows for specialization in one of three tracks: Applied Mathematics, Scientific Computing, or Pure Mathematics. This program is suitable for students with a bachelor's degree in mathematics, engineering, or a related field who are interested in pursuing a career in industry, government, or academia, or who plan to continue their studies at the doctoral level. Our program prepares students for a diverse range of careers where strong analytical and quantitative skills are highly valued.

The Ph.D. program in Meteorology and Physical Oceanography is designed to provide students with a broad and rigorous education in the atmospheric and ocean sciences. The program emphasizes both theoretical and applied aspects of meteorology and physical oceanography, with a strong focus on research. Students will develop a deep understanding of the fundamental physical principles governing the atmosphere and oceans, and gain the skills necessary to conduct independent research in these fields. The program prepares graduates for careers in academia, government, and industry.

The Sackler Institute of Graduate Biomedical Sciences offers PhD training programs in several basic science disciplines. The Sackler Institute at NYU Langone Health trains future leaders in biomedical research through graduate study in our seven PhD programs, an MD/PhD Program, and a variety of postdoctoral programs. Students benefit from the mentorship of more than 450 faculty members in 30 departments at NYU Grossman School of Medicine and other NYU schools and colleges who are pursuing biomedical research, with areas of expertise that include biochemistry, cell biology, genetics, molecular pharmacology, neuroscience, microbiology, immunology, and structural biology. Our students conduct research that spans the breadth of immunology and microbiology, from basic studies of host–pathogen interactions to translational studies of human diseases. Research topics include pathogenesis and host response to viral and bacterial infection, molecular mechanisms of immune cell development, inflammation and autoimmune disease, tumor immunity, vaccine development, and immunotherapy. Our interdisciplinary program draws faculty from multiple departments at NYU Langani Health, including Microbiology, Pathology, Medicine, and Pediatrics, as well as faculty from the NYU College of Dentistry and the NYU Tandon School of Engineering.

Molecular and Cellular Pharmacology, part of NYU Langone’s Vilcek Institute of Graduate Biomedical Sciences, is an interdisciplinary program designed to train students for careers in the pharmacological sciences. Our faculty members work across various basic science and clinical departments and institutes to investigate all aspects of drug action, from understanding the initial molecular steps of drug binding to target identification, cellular mechanisms, and therapeutic outcomes.

The program includes coursework, laboratory rotations, seminars, and thesis research, with an emphasis on hands-on laboratory experience. Our program offers many opportunities for collaborative research, including those with scientists at NYU Langone’s Perlmutter Cancer Center, Cardiovascular Research Center, Neuroscience Institute, and Vaccine Center.
