Research in Molecular, Cell and Developmental Biology addresses fundamental questions in biological processes at the molecular, cellular, and organismal levels. We study gene expression, protein structure and function, cell signaling, cell division, cell differentiation, development, and disease using a variety of model systems including bacteria, yeast, plants, flies, worms, fish, and mice, as well as cultured mammalian cells. We apply biochemical, biophysical, genetic, genomic, and imaging approaches to uncover fundamental mechanisms that control the function of cells and organisms.
Program name: Molecular Cell and Developmental Biology PhD

description: The MFA in Film at NYU Tisch School of the Arts is a three-year graduate filmmaking program focused on developing exceptional storytellers. Our students hone their craft by making films from day one, mastering the different roles of the filmmaking process, from directing, writing, and producing to cinematography, sound, and editing. Students develop their unique voices and visions through extensive hands-on experience, rigorous coursework, and close mentorship with our award-winning faculty. Our approach is to foster a collaborative and creative environment where students experiment with different genres and forms, push boundaries, and create original works that resonate with audiences worldwide. Our alumni go on to become successful filmmakers, screenwriters, producers, cinematographers, and editors, shaping the future of cinema and storytelling.

The Master of Music in Instrumental Performance is designed for highly qualified performers who wish to pursue careers as professional musicians and teachers. As a student in this program, you will focus on developing your artistic identity while cultivating the technical skills, artistry, and musicianship necessary for a successful career in today’s music world. You will take private lessons and participate in large and small ensembles and chamber music. You will also have opportunities to participate in master classes with renowned guest artists and faculty members, and to perform in various recitals, concerts, and special events throughout the year. You will develop your professional network in New York City and beyond, and gain the skills necessary to pursue your musical career. Your curriculum will also include academic studies in music theory, history, and pedagogy, enabling you to become a well-rounded musician and educator.

The Doctor of Musical Arts (DMA) in Music Performance at NYU Steinhardt is designed to prepare musician-scholars for careers in performance and/or teaching at the university level. Our unique curriculum combines high-level performance training with rigorous academic study in areas such as performance studies, music history, and music theory. You will complete your degree with a final dissertation that may include a written document, a lecture recital, or a combination of both. You’ll also perform a series of required recitals throughout your time in the program. You'll learn to become a well-rounded musician-scholar through: Intensive one-on-one instruction with our distinguished performance faculty; Advanced studies in music history, theory, and performance studies; Participation in NYU’s world-class performance ensembles; Opportunities for advanced study in related fields, such as music education, music technology, and performing arts administration; Engage with the vibrant musical life of New York City through master classes, concerts, and collaborations with leading artists and institutions.

The Music Business Fundamentals Certificate Online provides students with an overview of the music industry from a business perspective. Through engaging video lectures, dynamic discussions, and written assignments, students will gain insight into the structures, processes, and essential practices of the contemporary music business. This certificate focuses on the fundamentals of the industry, including music publishing and licensing, copyrights, distribution, record labels, and how artists are managed and promoted. Students will explore traditional and modern business models, learning how the internet and new technologies have shaped the industry and are changing the way music is created, marketed, and consumed.

Prepare for a dynamic career in the evolving music industry with our MA in Music Business. Ranked among the top music business programs in the world, we offer a rigorous, interdisciplinary curriculum, unmatched internship opportunities, and unparalleled access to the global music industry in the heart of New York City. Students gain the knowledge and skills for leadership roles across all sectors of the music industry. You'll learn from world-renowned faculty and industry leaders through real-world projects, case studies, guest speakers, and hands-on experiences. Graduates work in all areas of the industry, including record companies, music publishers, artist management firms, concert promotion companies, music technology firms, media and entertainment companies, and as entrepreneurs and independent artists. Through this program, you will also learn about: Music business history and evolution; The economics and legal aspects of the music business; Current trends, strategies, and challenges in the global music industry; Digital distribution, marketing, and monetization strategies; Artist management, concert promotion, and live entertainment; Entrepreneurship, innovation, and leadership in music; Data analytics and research methods for decision-making; International music markets and global business practices; Practical skills through internships and industry projects.

The MA in Music Business program at NYU Steinhardt provides students with a comprehensive curriculum in areas such as record company operations, music publishing, artist management, digital distribution, marketing, and entrepreneurship. You'll gain valuable experience through internships, special projects, and opportunities to network with professionals in New York City and beyond. Graduates of our program become leaders in record companies, music publishing companies, artist management firms, concert promotion companies, music products firms, and many new ventures. Our faculty members are leading executives in the music industry who integrate theory and practice throughout the curriculum. Our alumni are working in virtually every sector of the music industry in the US and around the world. The MA in Music Business is offered both on campus and online. The online program is designed for working professionals who wish to advance their careers in the global music industry.

The Master of Arts (MA) in Music Education program will prepare you to be an innovative music educator in a range of settings. As a graduate student, you'll choose a focus in one of the following areas to suit your interests and career goals: Instrumental, Vocal, and General Music Teaching; Music and the Creative Technologies; Music Education and Special Education; or Music Therapy. Our program is known for its strong faculty, who are leaders in their fields, and for its diverse student body. You'll have opportunities to engage in research, creative projects, and performances, and to collaborate with faculty and peers on various initiatives. Our alumni are successful practitioners, scholars, and leaders in music education worldwide.

The Music Education MM with Certification program at NYU Steinhardt is for students seeking a master’s degree and initial or professional New York State teacher certification. This program is for students who have completed an undergraduate degree and are seeking teacher certification in music education, or for professional teachers who already have initial certification and are seeking a master’s degree and professional certification. This program combines advanced academic study in music education with required coursework and field experiences that prepare you to become a certified music educator. Upon successful completion of the program, you will be recommended for initial or professional certification.
Accreditation status: Registered by the New York State Education Department (NYSED); Accredited by the National Association of Schools of Music (NASM)

description: The PhD in Music Education provides an intensive program of study in research and scholarship, preparing students for careers as university professors and researchers. In this program, students develop a deep understanding of philosophical, historical, psychological, and sociological aspects of music teaching and learning. Graduates become leaders in the field, making significant contributions to music education scholarship and practice. Our doctoral program offers a concentration in research within a broad range of music education topics. Our faculty have expertise in areas such as music performance, music teacher education, urban music education, popular music, music technology, early childhood music, social justice, psychology of music, arts and humanities, music history, and ethnomusicology. Students pursue coursework in areas of their interest related to their dissertation research.

Our PhD in Music Education, with a specialization in Music Therapy, is designed for experienced music therapists who hold a master’s degree and wish to pursue advanced study and research in music therapy. This specialization aims to develop leaders in research, higher education, and clinical practice, fostering critical inquiry and the generation of new knowledge in the field. You’ll gain the research competencies necessary to contribute to the body of knowledge in music therapy, explore advanced clinical topics, and prepare for leadership roles in academic or professional settings. The curriculum integrates advanced coursework in music education research methods, music therapy theory and practice, and opportunities for independent research culminating in a dissertation. Our faculty are recognized experts in their respective fields, providing mentorship and guidance throughout your doctoral journey.
Program name: Music Education PhD with Music Therapy Emphasis

description: The Steinhardt Master of Music in Music Technology program trains musicians and media artists to work at an advanced level in the rapidly changing fields of music technology, production, and sonic arts. The MM in Music Technology can be completed on a full-time or part-time basis. Full-time students typically finish the program in two years, while part-time students can take up to five years. The program prepares students to become leaders in various careers, including audio engineering, music production, sound design, new media, scoring for film and games, and music business. Our curriculum balances theoretical coursework with hands-on practice, empowering students to develop a deep understanding of audio engineering, music production, sound synthesis, interactive media, and other cutting-edge technologies. Students learn to use industry-standard software and hardware, gaining practical experience that prepares them for success in diverse fields. Through our program, you'll develop your artistic vision, technical expertise, and critical thinking skills, enabling you to push the boundaries of music and sound.

The Online Music Entrepreneurship Certificate offers a structured pathway for students to delve into the rapidly evolving landscape of the music industry. Designed for aspiring music professionals, artists, managers, and entrepreneurs, this program provides a comprehensive understanding of business strategies, digital technologies, and legal frameworks essential for success in today’s music ecosystem. Through a blend of theoretical knowledge and practical application, students will gain the skills and insights needed to navigate challenges, identify opportunities, and innovate within the dynamic world of music.

The Music Rights Administration and Licensing Certificate Online is designed to give you an overview of the legal and business aspects of music licensing and copyright. The program is specifically structured to offer working professionals and recent college graduates a broad understanding of the music business, with a specific focus on administration, rights, and licensing. Throughout the program, you will gain the knowledge and skills necessary to navigate the complexities of music rights, including copyright, publishing, synchronization, and master use licensing. You will learn about the various types of licenses, their associated fees, and the negotiation process. Additionally, you will explore the roles of performing rights organizations (PROs), collection societies, and other industry players. Upon completion, you will have a comprehensive understanding of the music rights landscape and be equipped to pursue careers in music publishing, music supervision, and licensing.
Program name: Music Rights Administration and Licensing Certificate Online

description: As one of the world's most renowned and comprehensive programs, the MA in Music Therapy at NYU Steinhardt provides you with the skills, knowledge, and experience needed to become a board-certified music therapist. Our curriculum emphasizes clinical practice, research, and theory, preparing you to work with diverse populations in various settings. You will gain a deep understanding of music therapy principles, techniques, and ethical considerations, developing your abilities to assess, plan, implement, and evaluate music therapy interventions effectively.
Accreditation status: Our program is approved by the American Music Therapy Association (AMTA). Graduates of the MA in Music Therapy program are eligible to sit for the board certification examination administered by the Certification Board for Music Therapists (CBMT). Successful completion of this examination leads to the credential MT-BC (Music Therapist - Board Certified), which is required for professional practice in most settings.

Program name: Music Therapy MM with Undergraduate Equivalency

description: At NYU Steinhardt, we offer master of music (MM) and doctor of philosophy (PhD) degrees in Musicology, with concentrations in Historical Musicology and Ethnomusicology. As a student in our program, you will develop expertise in the study of music through historical, cultural, and ethnographic methodologies. Our faculty specialize in a wide array of musical traditions and periods, including Western art music (medieval to present), African diasporic music, African music, Black music, Asian music, popular music, and film music. Our master's and doctoral programs provide a strong foundation for a variety of career paths in academia, arts administration, performance, and other fields that require a rigorous intellectual approach to music.

The Philosophy Department does not offer a terminal MA program. However, students who have successfully completed one year of the PhD program may apply to receive an MA from NYU. This MA is not a prerequisite for the PhD program, nor does it guarantee admission to the PhD program. For more information, please refer to the PhD Admissions section.

The NYU Philosophy Department offers a Ph.D. program designed to provide students with a broad and deep education in philosophy. Our program is recognized for its excellence in both core areas of philosophy and emerging fields, and for the strength of its faculty across a wide range of specialties. The Ph.D. program aims to train students to be excellent philosophers and successful academics. It typically takes five years of coursework and dissertation writing to complete the degree. Our rigorous curriculum, close faculty mentorship, and vibrant intellectual community prepare students for successful careers in academia and beyond. Students complete coursework in various areas of philosophy, including history of philosophy, metaphysics, epistemology, ethics, political philosophy, philosophy of mind, and logic. They are expected to develop strong research skills, culminating in the writing and defense of a doctoral dissertation. While students are not required to select a specific concentration or area of specialization upon admission, they are encouraged to explore their interests through seminars, research, and collaboration with faculty.

Prepare for a rewarding career helping people restore and improve movement with our Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) program. At NYU Steinhardt, you’ll learn evidence-based skills to provide ethical, client-centered care. Become a leader in physical therapy practice, research, and education. You’ll be prepared for careers in hospitals, rehabilitation centers, private practices, and community clinics. As a student in our Doctor of Physical Therapy program, you’ll be trained to work with patients across the lifespan in a variety of settings. Through courses, hands-on clinical experiences, and research opportunities, you will learn to: Conduct comprehensive evaluations and assessments of patients. Develop and implement individualized treatment plans. Promote health and wellness through education and preventative strategies. Collaborate with other healthcare professionals to optimize patient outcomes. Engage in scholarly inquiry and contribute to the advancement of physical therapy.
Accreditation status: The Doctor of Physical Therapy Program at New York University is accredited by the Commission on Accreditation in Physical Therapy Education (CAPTE), 3030 Potomac Ave., Suite 100, Alexandria, Virginia 22305-3085; telephone: 703-706-3245; email: accreditation@apta.org; website: http://www.capteonline.org. If needing to contact the program/institution directly, please call 212-998-9310 or email pt.steinhardt@nyu.edu.

description: The Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Research Physical Therapy is for physical therapists who want to advance the evidence-base of physical therapy practice through research. The curriculum focuses on developing the critical thinking, research, and scholarship skills required to conduct rigorous and impactful clinical and translational research. Students gain knowledge in specific areas of inquiry related to physical therapy, including movement science, neuroscience, rehabilitation science, and health services research. Graduates are prepared for careers as independent researchers and academics in university settings, research institutes, and clinical research centers.

The M.S. in Physics program provides a solid foundation in the core areas of physics while also allowing for some specialization. Students pursuing the M.S. degree at NYU typically do so for one of two reasons: either to strengthen their background in physics before applying to a Ph.D. program, or to acquire the knowledge base for a career in industry. The program can be completed with or without a thesis option.

M.S. students pursuing the non-thesis option complete a total of 32 points, or eight graduate courses. These courses include two required courses (General Physics I and II) and six elective courses. Electives can be taken from the range of graduate courses offered by the Department of Physics, in topics such as classical mechanics, quantum mechanics, electrodynamics, statistical mechanics, and more specialized areas like astrophysics, condensed matter physics, and particle physics.

M.S. students pursuing the thesis option also complete 32 points, which includes six graduate courses (24 points) and an M.S. thesis (8 points). The thesis involves original research conducted under the supervision of a faculty member and culminates in a written thesis and oral defense. The thesis option provides valuable research experience, often leading to publications, and is particularly beneficial for students considering doctoral studies.

Both options offer flexibility in course selection, allowing students to tailor their academic path to their interests and career goals. Students have access to state-of-the-art research facilities and opportunities to collaborate with leading faculty members on cutting-edge research projects.

The Ph.D. program in Physics is designed for students seeking to conduct original research and contribute to the scientific community. The program offers a rigorous curriculum covering foundational aspects of physics as well as advanced topics in various subfields. Students work closely with faculty mentors on cutting-edge research projects, leading to the development of a dissertation based on original scholarly work. Graduates are prepared for careers in academia, industrial research, government laboratories, and other science-related fields.

Our online option for the MA in Music Education with a Concentration in Popular Music Pedagogy offers working professionals a flexible, part-time path to advanced study. You’ll engage in a comprehensive curriculum covering popular music history, pedagogy, technology, and performance, preparing you to lead and innovate in various educational and community settings. Through a blend of synchronous and asynchronous learning activities, you’ll collaborate with faculty and peers, deepen your understanding of diverse musical genres, and develop practical skills to effectively teach popular music. This program is designed for current and aspiring music educators who want to expand their expertise in popular music and contribute to its growing presence in educational curricula.

The MS in Prevention Science and Community Health is an interdisciplinary program designed to train future public health leaders and researchers who will develop, implement, and evaluate evidence-based interventions to improve health and health equity within communities. The program addresses the increasing demand for professionals skilled in understanding and addressing complex public health issues through a prevention science lens. Students will gain expertise in theoretical frameworks, research methodologies, and practical skills necessary to translate scientific discoveries into effective community-based programs and policies. Graduates will be prepared to work in a variety of settings, including government agencies, non-profit organizations, research institutions, and academic settings, making significant contributions to public health.
Program name: Prevention Science and Community Health MS

description:
Our PhD in Public Health, Prevention Science & Community Health (PSCH) program trains research scientists to develop and evaluate interventions to prevent disease and promote health in community, clinical, and policy settings.
As a student in the PSCH PhD program, you will develop:
*   An understanding of the etiology and course of health-related behaviors and conditions using both qualitative and quantitative methods.
*   Expertise in the design, implementation, and evaluation of evidence-based interventions to improve health outcomes, reduce health disparities, and promote health equity.
*   The ability to disseminate research findings effectively to scientific and lay audiences.
Graduates of our PhD in Public Health, Prevention Science & Community Health program pursue careers in academia, government, and non-profit organizations, as well as positions in private industry and healthcare.
Program name: Prevention Science and Community Health PhD

description: Translational Surface Engineering (TSE) is a new, interdisciplinary Master of Science (MS) program that aims to equip engineers and scientists with the knowledge and skills required to solve critical challenges in developing advanced materials and devices. This is a unique program because it aims to provide students with a holistic understanding of surface engineering, including surface characterization, modification, and functionalization techniques, as well as their applications in various fields. The program focuses on the practical application of surface engineering principles to real-world problems in sectors such as biomedical, aerospace, automotive, energy, and consumer products. Students will gain expertise in areas like nanotechnology, biomaterials, coatings, and advanced manufacturing processes, preparing them for careers in research and development, product design, and process optimization. Through a combination of theoretical coursework, hands-on laboratory experience, and industry-sponsored projects, students will learn to design, synthesize, and characterize novel surface materials, analyze their performance, and translate their findings into innovative solutions. The curriculum emphasizes critical thinking, problem-solving, and interdisciplinary collaboration, fostering a new generation of engineers who can bridge the gap between scientific discovery and technological innovation.
Program name: Product Design MS in Cosmetics and Consumer Goods
Product Design MS in Pharmaceutical and Biopharmaceutical

description: The NYU Wagner Evaluation Certificate provides students with the critical skills needed to design, implement, and manage effective evaluation strategies. Designed for working professionals, this certificate offers flexible course schedules and can be completed in one year or less. Students acquire essential evaluation skills including how to frame an evaluable program, identify program theories of change, select appropriate evaluation designs, implement mixed methods, analyze data, and communicate findings to various audiences. Students who complete the certificate will be prepared to take on evaluation roles in a variety of public, nonprofit, and private sector organizations. Students who complete the Evaluation Certificate will be able to: Frame an evaluable program; Identify appropriate theories of change; Select appropriate evaluation designs; Conduct mixed methods evaluations; Analyze qualitative and quantitative data; Communicate findings to various audiences.

The Advanced Certificate for Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP) program prepares registered nurses for advanced practice roles focused on providing comprehensive mental healthcare to individuals, families, and communities across the lifespan. Building on a foundation of advanced nursing theory, research, and evidence-based practice, the program emphasizes critical thinking, clinical reasoning, and therapeutic interventions to promote mental health and prevent mental illness. Graduates are equipped to assess, diagnose, treat, and manage a wide range of psychiatric conditions, as well as provide psychoeducation, counseling, and collaboration with interdisciplinary teams. The curriculum integrates didactic coursework with extensive supervised clinical experiences, ensuring proficiency in psychopharmacology, psychotherapy, and cultural competence.
Program name: Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner Certificate

description: The MS in Applied Behavior Analysis program at NYU Steinhardt provides professional and academic training for individuals interested in the theoretical and practical application of the principles of behavior. You will gain a strong foundation in behavioral principles and concepts and learn how to apply these principles to address socially significant behaviors, particularly in individuals with developmental disabilities. You'll gain expertise in designing, implementing, and evaluating behavioral interventions, conducting functional behavior assessments, and supervising others. This program prepares you to become a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA), a globally recognized certification for professionals in applied behavior analysis. You'll learn to analyze and understand behavior, develop effective interventions, and apply evidence-based strategies in various settings. The curriculum emphasizes practical application through supervised fieldwork, research opportunities, and hands-on experiences.
Accreditation status: Our Verified Course Sequence (VCS) is approved by the Association for Behavior Analysis International (ABAI) and meets the coursework requirements for eligibility to take the Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) examination.

Concentration name: Cognition & Perception, Developmental Psychology, Social Psychology, Neuroscience & Psychology
description: The PhD in Psychology is an advanced research degree. The graduate program provides rigorous training in psychological science for students who wish to pursue careers in research and academia. The program emphasizes strong quantitative and methodological training, which students use to conduct original empirical research. Students learn to develop original ideas and test them empirically through coursework, seminars, and intensive research apprenticeships with faculty mentors. The program aims to foster the development of independent scholars who will make significant contributions to the field of psychological science. The typical time to degree is five years of full-time study. Most students are fully funded with a tuition waiver and stipends during their time in the program.

Concentration name: Financial Management, International Development, Management & Leadership, Policy Analysis, Public Policy Analysis, Social Impact, Innovation, and Investment, Urban Planning
description: The Master of Public Administration (MPA) at NYU Wagner is one of the nation’s top graduate professional degrees. It prepares students from a wide range of backgrounds to be leaders who can translate ideas into action and move society forward. Our flexible curriculum allows students to gain the analytical and management skills necessary to be effective public service leaders, while also specializing in a policy area or management function of their choosing. You’ll learn how to analyze and shape policy; manage people, projects, and organizations; and communicate effectively with stakeholders. Our graduates are equipped to lead mission-driven organizations in government, nonprofits, and the private sector, in New York City and around the world.

The Public Health Certificate provides an introduction to the core functions of public health and population health. This 12-credit certificate provides students with foundational knowledge in the disciplines of epidemiology, biostatistics, environmental health, social and behavioral sciences, and health policy and management. The certificate is designed for students seeking to gain a basic understanding of public health principles or those who wish to enhance their professional skills in areas related to population health. The certificate is especially useful for clinicians, social workers, educators, and other professionals who work with diverse populations.
Accreditation status: NYU Public Health is CEPH accredited.

description: The NYU GPH Master of Public Health (MPH) is a 45-credit professional degree available in 10 concentrations that train students to be leaders in the public health field. Through a required core curriculum, students gain foundational knowledge of the principles and practice of public health, along with practical skills through hands-on experiences. Our graduates are prepared to address pressing public health challenges locally and globally in a variety of settings.
Accreditation status: The NYU School of Global Public Health is accredited by the Council on Education for Public Health (CEPH).

Concentration name: Applied Biostatistics, Community Health, Global Health
description:
NYU GPH’s online Master of Public Health program brings the entire public health field to you. Designed to accommodate the needs of working professionals, the rigorous program is rooted in the school’s core values of research, education, and service, ensuring you will graduate with the skills to address pressing public health issues.

As an online MPH student, you will learn the core disciplines of public health, along with topics in epidemiology, biostatistics, environmental health, health policy, and social and behavioral sciences. Students also choose one of three concentrations – custom-designed for the online format: Applied Biostatistics, Community Health, or Global Health. Our online MPH delivers a diverse and engaging curriculum that builds on your career experiences and prepares you for leadership roles in various public health fields.
Accreditation status: Accredited by the Council on Education for Public Health (CEPH).

description: Designed for students with a professional degree, strong research interests, or prior experience in the field of public health, the Master of Science in Public Health (MSPH) program at NYU’s School of Global Public Health provides advanced methodological, analytical, and data-driven skills needed for public health practice and research. The MSPH enables students to deepen their understanding of critical public health issues while developing the leadership and communication skills necessary to create positive change within complex health systems. With hands-on opportunities to apply theory to real-world challenges, students gain the tools to design, implement, and evaluate public health interventions. The 45-credit MSPH program has a strong research and practice focus, enabling students to gain advanced methodological and analytic skills with a strong foundation in public health science. Students complete a 6-credit Applied Practice Experience (APEX) and an 8-credit Master’s Thesis (Capstone) as part of the curriculum. The program culminates in a comprehensive exam. Graduates are prepared for doctoral study or for leadership roles in diverse public health organizations.
Accreditation status: Accredited by the Council on Education for Public Health (CEPH)

description: The Public Health Accelerated Master of Science in Public Health (MSPH) offers a rigorous academic experience to those interested in careers that require both depth and breadth of public health knowledge and competencies. The accelerated MSPH is designed to provide students with the foundational skills of public health and advanced knowledge in an area of concentration. Students pursuing the Public Health Accelerated MSPH program are eligible to pursue one of the following concentrations: Community Health Science and Practice, Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Environmental Public Health Sciences, Global Health, or Social and Behavioral Sciences. The program prepares students for various public health positions in governmental, non-governmental, and private sector organizations. The curriculum builds on a foundation in core public health disciplines and culminates in a 180-hour applied practice experience and a culminating experience that integrates knowledge across public health domains. The MSPH is an accelerated program designed for students with at least two years of full-time work experience or a master’s degree in a relevant field. This program is completed in 10 months and applicants must have a bachelor's degree to apply.
Accreditation status: NYU GPH is fully accredited by the Council on Education for Public Health (CEPH).

Concentration name: Economic Development Policy, Education Policy, Environmental Policy, Health Policy, Housing and Community Development Policy, International Development Policy, Management and Leadership, Nonprofit Management, Policy Analysis, Public Finance, Social Policy, Technology Policy, Urban Policy
description: The Master of Science (MS) in Public Policy is a two-year, 45-credit degree program for students seeking an intensive, analytical education focused on domestic public policy. The program provides a multidisciplinary social science education, developing students’ analytical and methodological skills to understand, analyze, and address domestic policy issues. Students learn to apply quantitative and qualitative methods to evaluate the causes, consequences, and effectiveness of public policies. The curriculum combines a common core with opportunities for specialization, offering students an in-depth understanding of the forces that shape public policy in specific policy domains.
